title: Planner - Goals plan file
description: A goal plan file, as Export writes it and Import reads it (format "goal-plan", version 1). This schema says what a JSON Schema can say. Import also checks what it cannot: a date must be a real day from 1900 to 2200 (2026-02-30 and 2300-01-01 match the pattern but are refused); every `parent` names the `id` of a goal in the file; each `id` is used once; text lengths count after trimming. Use the Check file entry in the Export and import menu for those.
$comment: The format is written out in FORMAT.md beside this file. Fields that are not listed are ignored by Import, so additionalProperties is left open.

id.description: 1 to 64 letters, digits, dashes or underscores; used once in the file. Needed only when another entry names this one.

title.description: Up to 200 characters, not only spaces.

parent.description: The id of a goal in the file. A step needs one; a goal has none.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a real day from 1900 to 2200 (checked by Import, not by this pattern).

owners.description: People's keys; leave out unless the file came from this environment.

then.$comment: A note has no done and no date; Import ignores them. It may name a goal as its parent, or sit at the top.
